verdict.rationale: Aliases and masked addresses are a fair axis for an email service like Outlook, but the evidence pack never mentions email aliases, masked or relay addresses, or hiding the real address from sign-ups. The nearby documented features do not qualify: delegated send-on-behalf, Inbox forwarding rules and custom headers are different capabilities.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
